scope: Finite current isolation/access guard predicates; three UNSAT original-profile controls and four SAT original/new-component nonvacuity witnesses. Guards are transcribed/reviewed premises, not Python/SQL source refinement or proof of native installation/authority.

results.name: original stable subject and fresh source guards have no shared native transaction profile
results.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun isolation () Int)
(declare-fun read_only () Bool)
(assert
 (let (($x12 (= isolation 2)))
 (let (($x10 (= isolation 1)))
 (let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
 (or $x8 $x10 $x12)))))
(assert
 (let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
(let (($x17 (and $x8 (not read_only))))
(let (($x15 (and (or (= isolation 1) (= isolation 2)) read_only)))
(and $x15 $x17)))))
(check-sat)

; benchmark generated from python API

(declare-fun isolation () Int)
(declare-fun same_original_host_operation () Bool)
(declare-fun declared_fact_cuts_held () Bool)
(declare-fun read_only () Bool)
(assert
 (let (($x12 (= isolation 2)))
 (let (($x10 (= isolation 1)))
 (let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
 (or $x8 $x10 $x12)))))
(assert
 (let (($x16 (not read_only)))
(let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
(let (($x17 (and $x8 $x16)))
(let (($x20 (and $x17 declared_fact_cuts_held same_original_host_operation)))
(and $x17 $x20))))))
(check-sat)

conclusion: The original stable read-only and fresh-source profiles still cannot compose. The new declared-fact fenced component uses compatible RC/RW under asserted held cuts and same original operation. This proves guard eligibility only, not actual complete dependency declarations, native writer closure, bypass-safe invoker grants, installed helper/profile authentication or current authority; no protected profile is admitted.
